thread:
Alice Chen: quick FYI - serializer-sampling canary for bridge-3b-ptq is showing a parse_fail_rate ~10.2% on sample=600. lots of trailing commas and stray backslashes in funcall outputs :eyes:
Ben Ortiz: is this PTQ-only or seen on fp32 baseline?
Alice Chen: fp32 run (same prompts) parse_fail_rate ~0.3%. looks quant-specific.
Carla Nguyen: paste a raw failing chunk? might be tokenization/escape issue.
Alice Chen: raw stream example:
```
{"tool":"lookup","args":{"id":"user:123"},}
```
(there's a trailing comma). Other example: `{"note":"C:\\Users\\"}` where model emits single backslash and leaves string open.
Jamal Price: could be quant kernels emitting backslash as separate token. any dependence on prefix length / kvcache?
Alice Chen: yes - failures concentrate at higher prefix lengths (kvcache hits). suggests kvprefix concatenation boundaries noisy under PTQ.
Ben Ortiz: do we have replays to repro deterministically? seed, max_tokens?
Alice Chen: saved repro in s3://redwood-canaries/serializer-sampling/repro-5322.jsonl (prompt, seed, model config per line).
Carla Nguyen: mitigation idea: add lightweight canary-only postproc: wrap single objects in array, strip trailing commas, escape-fix stray backslashes before JSON parse. Measure rescue.
Jamal Price: add A/B: kvcache ON vs OFF to disambiguate runtime vs model behavior.
Ben Ortiz: also test retry policy: re-request with temp=0.0 or decode chunking.
Alice Chen: soft-retry (temp=0.0) recovered ~25% of failures. sanitize+retry recovered ~80% on sample set.
Carla Nguyen: plan: 1) run two cohorts (ptq kvcache ON/OFF), 2) attach strict JSON schema checker logging rescue path (retry vs sanitize), 3) fp32 control.
Alice Chen: canary config draft:
```
canary_config:
  name: serializer-sampling-5322
  model: bridge-3b-ptq
  cohorts:
    - name: kvcache-on
      kvcache: true
    - name: kvcache-off
      kvcache: false
  samples: 1200
  strict_schema: true
  rescue_pipeline: ["wrap_array","repair_trailing_comma","retry_temp0"]
  metrics: ["parse_fail_rate","recovery_by_step","latency_p95"]
```
Ben Ortiz: add seed reproducibility and kernel tags.
Alice Chen: will add seed+kernel instrumentation and token-level diffs to pinpoint where backslash gets emitted.
Jamal Price: timeline?
Alice Chen: launching cohorts this afternoon; initial summary in ~24h.
deploy-bot: canary run started: serializer-sampling-5322 | bridge-3b-ptq | cohorts= kvcache-on/off | samples=1200
Ben Ortiz: if kvcache interaction confirmed, gate PTQ onboard rollouts until mitigation exists.
Carla Nguyen: also add unit test in funcall harness injecting boundary tokens to catch regressions early.
Alice Chen: noted - will post results and curated examples to the ticket when ready :thumbsup:
